prompt: logs/ has one directory per service (auth, billing, search, mailer), each holding plain and gzipped log files. Use one sub-agent per service, running in parallel, to count that service's log lines, its ERROR lines (the level is the third whitespace-separated field), and its most frequent error code among ERROR lines (the code is the fourth field; ties go to the smallest code). Then write summary.json as {"services": {"<service>": {"lines": N, "errors": N, "top_error": "E###"}, ...}, "total_errors": N}.
setup: git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.name=eval -c user.email=eval@example.com commit -qm init
